Phase-5.name: Hardening and product evidence
Phase-5.description: Close the audit gaps: production dependency security, release provenance, scoped verification, traceability, and measurable product evidence. Status stays wip while external adoption/quality measurement remains.

step-1.description: Scoped verification and command-surface truth after the v3.4 audit.

step-2.description: File-reader verification scoped to its declared tests.

step-3.description: Status snapshot verification scoped to its declared tests.

step-4.description: Path-safety verification scoped to its declared tests.

step-5.description: Impact analysis verification scoped to its declared tests.

step-6.description: Next-step advisor verification scoped to its declared tests.

step-7.description: Monorepo discovery verification scoped to its declared tests.

step-8.description: Sharded-index verification scoped to its declared tests.

step-9.description: Traceability verification scoped to its declared tests.

step-10.description: Diagram exporter verification scoped to its tests.

step-11.description: Optional integrations verification scoped to its tests.

step-12.description: External lint providers are trust-gated, audited and scoped.

step-13.description: Guidance packs, lockfile and Ed25519 attestation are verified.

step-14.description: Capsule routines remain experimental and verified.

step-15.description: External adoption and larger quality benchmark (N>=10, browser a11y) remain as product evidence.

step-17.description: Installer filesystem/backup helpers extracted and verified.

step-18.description: Lint changed-scope resolver extracted and verified.

step-16.description: Octocode code-graph adapter remains optional, trust-gated and scoped.

outcome.item-1: Production dependencies have no high/critical advisories and CI enforces the audit gate.
outcome.item-2: Release assets carry SHA-256 checksums and GitHub build provenance; docs match the workflow.
outcome.item-3: Every verification command is scoped to declared test files; no bare `bun test` remains.
outcome.item-4: Every module has a requirement and phase trace link.
outcome.item-5: Remaining product evidence (external adoption, N>=10 quality, browser a11y) is tracked explicitly.

deliverables.item-1: Updated bun.lock with zero production advisories and an `audit:prod` gate.
deliverables.item-2: Release workflow with SHA256SUMS and build provenance attestation.
deliverables.item-3: Scoped verification files and a policy test that rejects bare `bun test`.
deliverables.item-4: Requirements/phase trace links for every module and a closed Phase-4.
deliverables.item-5: ROADMAP/FOLLOWUP truth pass for the remaining evidence work.

acceptance-gates.item-2: `bun test test/verification-scoping.test.ts` passes and every module trace has no gaps.
acceptance-gates.item-3: `mygrace lint --strict` and `mygrace ci` pass on the repo.
acceptance-gates.item-4: release workflow packs SHA256SUMS and attaches provenance only for tag pushes.

risks.item-1: Dependency upgrades can break MCP behavior; full test suite plus stdio runtime tests must stay green.
risks.item-2: Attestation actions require id-token/attestations permissions; misconfiguration must fail the release, not silently skip.
risks.item-3: Scoped commands can be too narrow; declared test files and coverage remain the guardrail.
